senses.gloss: क्षेत्रीय kṣetrī-ya, den. P. desire a field.
क्षेपन् kṣep-an, m. throw: in. kṣepṇā, 🞄quickly.

क्षेपिष्ठ kṣép-iṣṭha, spv.;
 -īyas, cpv. of ksiprá: 🞄n. ad. as quickly as possible.

क्षेमकर kṣema-kara, a. affording peace and 🞄security;
 -kāra, kṛt, -ṃ -kara, a. id..

क्षेमय kṣema-ya, den. P. only pr. pt. resting;
 🞄affording rest, sheltering, refreshing.
क्षेमयोग kṣema-yoga, m. du. rest and labour.
क्षेमीश्वर kṣemi‿īśvara, m. N. of a poet.
क्षेमेन्द्र kṣema‿indra, m. N. of several authors.
